steps.hook: POV: you said you're good today and your chest was caving in.

steps.alt_text: Man in a crowd looking down alone dark cinematic. Overlay text reads: ...

steps.caption:
That "you're good" wasn't a lie. It was how you made it through the day without anyone asking for more.
When you live with social anxiety, your nervous system learns that being seen struggling feels more dangerous than suffering alone. So you perform fine. You smile on cue. You nod. You keep your hands still while your chest tightens behind the mask.
If you sat in your car after work because you couldn't carry it one more minute, you're not alone. You're not faking it, you're just tired of hiding the cost. Comment MASK and I'll send you the full breakdown.
#socialanxiety #overthinking #socialanxietystruggles #anxietyproblems #quietpeople #latenightthoughts

steps.hook: POV: the conversation pauses and your throat locks shut.

steps.alt_text: Man frozen mid conversation with someone dark cinematic. Overlay text ...

steps.caption:
That blank isn't you being awkward. It's your body pulling the emergency brake mid-sentence. Your throat tightens, your mind empties, you nod like you heard something you didn't.
When silence hits, your nervous system reads it as danger. It shuts down speech before you can say the wrong thing and get exposed. That's why you freeze when you actually know what to say. If your mind goes blank right when you need it most, you're not alone.
Comment BLANK and I'll send you the full breakdown.
#socialanxiety #overthinking #socialanxietystruggles #anxietyproblems #introvertstruggles #latenightthoughts
